caption_L1: This is a area chart called Number of Hyundai cars sold in Czechia from 2008 to 2019. The x-axis measures Year as a linear scale of range 2008 to 2018. A linear scale from 0 to 20,000 can be found along the y-axis, labeled Units sold.
caption_L2L3: There is an upward trend until 2017, reaching a peak of over 20,000 cars, then a slight drop back down by 2019 where a similar number of cars were sold as in 2014. In 2008 the lowest number was sold in the time period, between 7-8000 cars. The most cars were sold between 2016-2018.
